hens_rule_text: Chickens and their pens must be at least 100 ft from any other home, church, school or hospital, which rules out most ordinary city lots; where that distance is met, up to 30 chickens are allowed.
permit_notes: The current Chapter 6 text (Ordinance 2022-44) has no hen permit. An older Sec. 6-38/6-39 permit allowed up to 7 hens within the 100 ft zone for people with a doctor's certification; some sites still cite it, but it does not appear in the 2022 text.
setback_notes: Pens must be 100 ft, measured in a straight line, from any residence other than the owner's and from any church, school or hospital.
coop_rules: Pens must be cleaned and disinfected daily and limed every two days; droppings collected daily in a flytight container and hauled away at least weekly. Birds may not run at large.
zoning_notes: Sec. 6-35 caps the flock at 30 chickens, and at 40 of all fowl and rabbits combined on a lot of 65 by 125 ft or less. Roosters, male chickens and guinea fowl are banned citywide (Sec. 6-37, 6-38).
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.
